_meta.purpose: ATLAS blocker 1 - offline Swiss Ephemeris computation of Chiron + Ceres/Pallas/Juno/Vesta via pyswisseph
_meta.repo_local_ephe_dir: C:/AI/research-astrology/ephe (files already present, sizes match GitHub byte-for-byte)

files_needed.role: MAIN ASTEROIDS: Ceres(1), Pallas(2), Juno(3), Vesta(4), 2060 Chiron, 5145 Pholus - this single file covers ALL FIVE target bodies
planets Sun..Pluto (needed for solar position -> geocentric asteroid positions, and all planetary work)

download_urls.dropbox_long_named_asteroids: same Dropbox link, folder 'long_ast': >24,000 named asteroids, 6000-year files 3000 BCE-2999 CE (~11 GB)

naming_scheme_other_asteroids.long_files: se<NNNNN>.se1 e.g. se00433.se1 = asteroid no. 433 (Eros); cover 3000 BCE - 3000 CE
naming_scheme_other_asteroids.short_files: same name with embedded 's', e.g. se00433s.se1; cover 1500 - 2100 CE (readme says 1500-2099)
naming_scheme_other_asteroids.directory_rule: asteroid files must sit in subdirectories named ast<N> where N = asteroid number // 1000 (ast0..ast623); sepl*/semo*/seas* stay directly in the ephe path
naming_scheme_other_asteroids.note: individual ast*.se1 files are NOT in the GitHub ephe dir (only seas_/sepl_/semo_ series + astlistn.md index); they come from astro.com ftp / Dropbox

chiron.computable_range: 700 CE - 4650 CE (Saturn close encounters limit orbit beyond)

set_ephe_path_usage.code:
import swisseph as swe
swe.set_ephe_path(r'C:/AI/research-astrology/ephe')
jd_ut = swe.julday(1997, 5, 19, 5 + 45/60 - 7.0)   # local->UT handled manually
pos, ret = swe.calc_ut(jd_ut, swe.CHIRON, swe.FLG_SWIEPH | swe.FLG_SPEED)
pos2, _ = swe.calc_ut(jd_ut, swe.AST_OFFSET + 4, swe.FLG_SWIEPH | swe.FLG_SPEED)  # Vesta
set_ephe_path_usage.default_search_path_note: without set_ephe_path SE searches \sweph\ephe (Win) or .:/users/ephe2/:/users/ephe/ (Unix); ';' is the Windows path separator, ':' or ';' on Linux
set_ephe_path_usage.working_reference_impl: verify_asteroids.py in this repo (runs green against these three files)

skyfield_confirmation.evidence: Skyfield docs (rhodesmill.org/skyfield/planets.html) print DE421's complete segment list: targets 1-9 barycenters, SUN(10), MOON(301), EARTH(399), EM BARYCENTER(3), MERCURY(199), VENUS(299), MARS(499). No asteroid or centaur segments exist.
skyfield_confirmation.workaround_if_skyfield_needed: only via external JPL HORIZONS-generated SPK files + third-party spktype01/spktype21 libs (skyfield docs demo exactly this for Chiron, target 2002060). Recommendation: use Swiss Ephemeris for these bodies.

chiron_ground_truth.subject: M (chart M in this repo)
